text:
maria: Quick pulse — catalog greenlist readycheck. We need a short sync on licensing gaps, perf profiles, and canary window before we flip the ingest.

simon: I ran the compatibility matrix last night. Two models flagged: nova-lite (unclear dataset provenance) and zephyr-ckpt (GPL-ish derivative). Need legal to confirm.

kevin: On perf, nova-lite passes our latency SLO at batch sizes 8/16 but the memory cliff at 24 tokens is real. Proposing quantization profile q4_az for canary.

anya: Can we avoid changing shapes for the canary? Our embedding pipeline expects float32 dims=1536. If we change quantization we need a short adaptor layer.

legal-bot: @simon I attached the license excerpts in #vendors last night. Summary: nova-lite requires attribution only, zephyr-ckpt has a questionable redistribution clause. @maria want a formal review or do we block on legal hold?

maria: Let's not block the whole batch. Proposal: greenlist everything except zephyr-ckpt; run zephyr through expedited legal review (2 business days). We still need owners and canary plan.

ben: Owner matrix: I can take nova-lite for runtime tuning. @anya you ok to own the adapter for quantization compatibility?

anya: Yes, I'll build an adaptor shim and a small end-to-end test. ETA Thu EOD. I'll post a PR and attach a test dataset.

carol: Canary windows — ops prefers Tue/Wed 10–12 PST for low-traffic. We should do staggered ramp: 1% -> 10% -> 25% over 3 hours with rollback triggers on 5xxs or latency p95>350ms.

kevin: Quant profile test plan: local microbench + staging canary run. I'll baseline q4_az vs q8 and upload perf artifacts to the ticket.

maria: Great. Action items: (1) legal expedite zephyr-ckpt (assigned: legal-bot/simon) (2) adapter PR (assigned: anya) (3) quant perf artifacts (assigned: kevin) (4) canary schedule & runbook (assigned: carol/ops) (5) manifest update with provenance + profile tags (assigned: ben). Please comment in this thread when done.

simon: Re: manifest — small schema suggestion: add fields "provenance_link" and "license_summary" so curators don't need to dig each time. I'll draft a patch.

ben: Draft manifest snippet for nova-lite below:
```json
{
  "model_id": "nova-lite-v1",
  "provenance_link": "https://datasets.internal/nova/lineage",
  "license_summary": "CC-BY-4.0 attribution required",
  "perf_profile": "q4_az-latency-1536d",
  "owners": ["ben", "maria"]
}
```

maria: Love that. Ben — when you push manifest, include a short note on the rollback signal mapping.

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary window: 2026-03-20T10:00:00-08:00 -> 2026-03-20T13:00:00-08:00, rollout policy: staggered-percent.

anya: PR opened: https://git.redwood/infer/adaptor/pull/342 — includes unit tests and a quick perf stub.

kevin: Perf artifacts uploaded to the ticket: https://issues.redwood/ML-2487/artifacts — q4_az looks promising, p95 down ~18% vs q8 on staging.

legal-bot: Zephyr-ckpt review started. ETA 48 hours. Will ping when done.

maria: Thanks all. If there are no objections, we'll proceed with the canary as scheduled and keep zephyr blocked from the initial ingest. If legal clears zephyr early we'll add it as a follow-up canary. Please add any late blockers now. :thumbsup:
